purpose: Choose an external-price control family before pass-through estimation so the control is not selected after inspecting model fit.

preferred_direct_control.dataset: Eurostat sts_inpi_m — Import prices in industry, monthly data
evidence: Eurostat defines the indicator as monthly transaction-price development of imported industrial goods.
Under the European business-statistics framework euro-area countries are required to transmit import prices; only some non-euro EU/EFTA countries transmit them.

Current provider and dataset-mirror searches did not identify the standard Romania total-industry series. This is treated as non-confirmation, not proof that every possible Romanian subseries is absent.

preregistered_fallback.source_family: Eurostat International Trade in Goods Statistics — Indices by SITC/BEC/CPA
preregistered_fallback.target: Romania monthly import unit-value index for total imports/world, expressed in euro
rationale: Eurostat documents monthly and annual unit-value indices for imports and exports of each EU country, with coverage starting from January 2002 in the current user manual.
The indices are available in euro, national currency and US dollars.

For a RON/EUR pass-through equation, the euro-denominated import UVI is preferred over a RON-denominated UVI because a RON-denominated index would mechanically embed part of the exchange-rate conversion being studied.
Unit-value indices are constructed from trade values and quantities and can move with product composition; they are therefore an external-price proxy, not a pure transaction-price index.
required_dimensions_before_use: partner = world or the broadest stable world aggregate available
product = total goods or the broadest stable aggregate available
unit = unit-value index denominated in euro
preregistered_fallback.materialisation_rule: Do not estimate until the exact Eurostat dataset identifier, complete dimension tuple, coverage, revisions/vintage, raw-source hash and missingness are retained. If the exact requested UVI cannot be reproduced, return to SOURCE_CONTROL_UNRESOLVED rather than selecting a fit-improving substitute.
